title: Tech Note: Downloading Email with 4D Internet Commands

historical_commentary.text: Building custom email clients within 4D was a compelling use case in 1999, when free email clients were basic and integrating email with database workflows required custom development. The 4D Internet Commands plug-in provided POP3/SMTP support for this purpose. Modern 4D includes built-in IMAP, POP3, and SMTP commands (4D.POP3Transporter, 4D.IMAPTransporter, 4D.SMTPTransporter classes), making the plug-in approach obsolete. The use cases described—custom interfaces, sales automation integration, order processing, scheduled downloads—remain valid but are now served by built-in 4D capabilities or external APIs.
related_updates: 4D Internet Commands plug-in has been superseded by built-in transporter classes
IMAP (not available via the old plug-in) is now the standard for email retrieval
